outro_summary: Jane wants Red John so badly that he threatens the one ally protecting him. Then he catches Red John's man with a detail as small as nicotine gum, and Hardy confirms it himself. Lisbon wins the last exchange by naming the cost. Seven moves, and Red John still out of reach.
